```{r}
# Load in Libraries
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(terra)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
# Read in OHI region boundaries
ohi_regions <- st_read(here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) |> st_make_valid()
```

## Create buffer

```{r}
# Create 5km buffer (run once)
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

ohi_regions_marine <- ohi_regions |>
  filter(location == "marine") |>
  st_union()

# Make a buffer ring
buffer_outer <- st_buffer(ohi_regions_marine, dist = 20000)
buffer_ring  <- st_difference(buffer_outer, ohi_regions_marine) |> st_make_valid()

# Union it to the marine OHI layer
ohi_marine_plus_20km <- st_union(ohi_regions_marine, buffer_ring)
```



```{r}

gmw_1996 <- st_read(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/zenodo_mangrove/gmw_v3_1996_vec/gmw_v3_1996_vec.shp")) |>

gmw_2007 <- st_read(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/zenodo_mangrove/gmw_v3_2007_vec/gmw_v3_2007_vec.shp")) |> 
  st_make_valid()
gmw_2010 <- st_read(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/zenodo_mangrove/gmw_v3_2010_vec/gmw_v3_2010_vec.shp")) |> 
  st_make_valid()
gmw_2015 <- st_read(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/zenodo_mangrove/gmw_v3_2015_vec/gmw_v3_2015_vec.shp")) |> 
  st_make_valid()
gmw_2020 <- st_read(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/zenodo_mangrove/gmw_v3_2020_vec/gmw_v3_2020_vec.shp")) |> 
  st_make_valid()
gmw_2017 <- st_read(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/zenodo_mangrove/gmw_v3_2017_vec/gmw_v3_2017_vec.shp")) |>

# Match the CRS of mangrove and OHI data
gmw_1996 <- st_transform(gmw_1996, st_crs(ohi_regions))

```

```{r}
# Read in Hem data
hem_mangroves <- st_read(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/mangrove_Hem/USV_AGRUPADO/USV_AGRUPADO.shp")) |> 
  st_make_valid()

# Match hem data to OHI CRS
hem_mangroves <- st_transform(hem_mangroves, st_crs(ohi_regions))
```

```{r}
# 1996
# Clip mangrove data to the 20km buffer extent
gmw_1996 <- st_intersection(gmw_1996, ohi_marine_plus_20km)

# Find the mangrove area in each region
rgns_gmw_1996 <- st_intersection(gmw_1996, ohi_regions) |>
  group_by(rgn_id) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6,
    year = 1996
  ) |>
  st_drop_geometry()
```

## Current Status — COONABIO

```{r}
# Combine all data into one dataframe
gmw_area <- bind_rows(rgns_gmw_1996, rgns_gmw_2007, rgns_gmw_2010, rgns_gmw_2015, rgns_gmw_2017, rgns_gmw_2020) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(rgn_id, year) |>
  summarise(area_km2 = sum(area_km2), .groups = "drop")

# Calucalte current status
mangrove_condition <- gmw_area |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = area_km2) |>
  mutate(condition = `2020` / `1996`,
         condition = pmin(condition, 1),   # cap values > 1 at 1
         year = 2020) |>
  select(rgn_id, year, condition)
```

```{r}
# Make a nice Ktable
mangrove_condition |>
  filter(!rgn_id %in% c("Region_2", "Region_3")) |>
  kable(digits = 4, col.names = c("Region", "Year", "Condition (2020/1996)")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered")) |>
  add_header_above(
    c('Mangrove Condition' = 3))
```


## EXTENT — Hem MANGLAR (2025)

```{r}
# Filter hem data to only include mangrove layers
hem_mangroves_only <- hem_mangroves |>
  filter(DESCRIP_AG %in% c("MANGLAR", 
                           "VEGETACIÓN SECUNDARIA ARBÓREA DE MANGLAR", 
                           "VEGETACIÓN SECUNDARIA ARBUSTIVA DE MANGLAR",
                           "VEGETACIÓN SECUNDARIA HERBÁCEA DE MANGLAR")) |>
  st_union() |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  st_make_valid()
```

```{r}
# Clip mangrove data to the 20km buffer extent
hem_mangroves_only <- st_intersection(hem_mangroves_only, ohi_marine_plus_20km)

# Find the mangrove area in each region
rgns_hem <- st_intersection(hem_mangroves_only, ohi_regions) |>
  group_by(rgn_id) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(x), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6,
    year = 2025
  ) |>
  st_drop_geometry()

# Make a nice Ktable
rgns_hem |>
  kable(digits = 4, col.names = c("Region", "Extent (km²)", "Year")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered")) |>
  add_header_above(
    c('Mangrove Extent' = 3))
```




## TREND — GMW 2010 → 2020

```{r}
# Calculate trend in each region
mangrove_trend <- gmw_area |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = area_km2) |>
  mutate(trend = (`2020` / `2010`)^(1/10) - 1,
         year = 2020) |>
  select(rgn_id, year, trend)
```

I removed regions 2 and 3 from the final table due to their small areas and that mangroves aren't shows in these regions in Hems data.
```{r}
# Make a nice Ktable
mangrove_trend |>
  filter(!rgn_id %in% c("Region_2", "Region_3")) |>
  kable(digits = 4, col.names = c("Region", "Year", "Trend")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered")) |>
  add_header_above(
    c('Mangrove Trend' = 3))
```

```{r}
# Remove Regions 2 and 3 from condition and trend outputs
mangrove_condition_2 <- mangrove_condition %>% slice(-1, -2)
mangrove_trend_2 <- mangrove_trend %>% slice(-1, -2)
```

```{r}
# Write CSVs to output_data directory
write.csv(rgns_hem,
          "MAN_outputs/mangrove_extent.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(mangrove_trend_2,
          "MAN_outputs/mangrove_trend.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(mangrove_condition_2,
          "MAN_outputs/mangrove_condition.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```



```{r}
mangrove_condition_clean <- mangrove_condition |>
  mutate(
    condition_int = round(condition * 100, 1),
    condition_int = ifelse(rgn_id %in% c("Region_2", "Region_3"), NA, condition_int)
  )


# Join onto OHI polygons
ohi_mangrove_condition <- ohi_regions |>
  left_join(mangrove_condition_clean, by = "rgn_id")

# Split marine vs land
ohi_marine <- ohi_mangrove_condition |> filter(location == "marine")
ohi_land   <- ohi_mangrove_condition |> filter(location == "land")

# Plot
tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(ohi_land) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "#f5e6c8",
    border.col = "gray40",
    lwd = 1,
    alpha = 0.5,
    legend.show = FALSE
  ) +

tm_shape(ohi_marine) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "condition_int",
    palette = "RdYlGn",
    alpha = 0.7,
    title = "Current Status",
    border.col = "black",
    lwd = 1.2
  ) +

tm_layout(
  title = "Mangrove Current Status (2020)",
  frame = FALSE,
  legend.outside = TRUE
)

```
```{r}
mangrove_condition_table <- mangrove_condition_clean |>
  left_join(
    ohi_regions |> 
      filter(location == "marine") |> 
      select(rgn_id, ecorgn),
    by = "rgn_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    rgns_hem |> 
      select(rgn_id, area_km2),
    by = "rgn_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Clean region labels
    rgn_id = gsub("_", " ", rgn_id),
    ecorgn = gsub("_", " ", ecorgn),

    # Replace ecorgn with your custom region names
    ecorgn = case_when(
      rgn_id == "Region 1" ~ "Western Upper Gulf",
      rgn_id == "Region 2" ~ "Western Midriff Islands",
      rgn_id == "Region 3" ~ "Western Central Gulf",
      rgn_id == "Region 4" ~ "Western Southern Gulf",
      rgn_id == "Region 5" ~ "Eastern Upper Gulf",
      rgn_id == "Region 6" ~ "Eastern Midriff Islands",
      rgn_id == "Region 7" ~ "Eastern Sonora Coast",
      rgn_id == "Region 8" ~ "Sinaloa Coast",
      rgn_id == "Region 9" ~ "Southeastern Gulf",
      TRUE ~ ecorgn
    ),

    area_km2 = round(area_km2, 2),
    condition_int = round(condition_int, 1)
  ) |>
  select(
    rgn_id,
    ecorgn,
    area_km2,
    condition_int
  )

mangrove_condition_table |>
  filter(!rgn_id %in% c("Region 2", "Region 3")) |>   # <-- remove 2 & 3 here
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Region ID", "Region Name", "Extent (km²)", "Current Status (%)")
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) |>
  add_header_above(c("Mangrove Current Status" = 4))


```

```{r}
# Add a dummy column for legend labeling
hem_mangroves_only$habitat <- "Mangrove Habitat"

tmap_mode("plot")

# 1. OHI regions (no legend)
tm_shape(ohi_regions) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "location",
    palette = c("marine" = "#cceeff",
                "land"   = "#f5e6c8"),
    alpha = 0.5,
    border.col = "gray",
    border.lwd = 1,
    legend.show = FALSE
  ) +

# 2. Mangrove habitat polygons
tm_shape(hem_mangroves_only) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "habitat",
    palette = c("Mangrove Habitat" = "#228B22"),   # dark green
    alpha = 1,
    border.col = "#228B22",
    border.lwd = 2,
    title = "Habitat"
  ) +

# 3. Layout + scale bar (no title)
tm_layout(
    frame = FALSE,
    legend.outside = TRUE
  ) +
tm_scale_bar(position = c("center", "bottom"))

```

```{r}
rgn_colors <- c(
  "Region_1" = "#C03729",
  "Region_2" = "#E68C7C",
  "Region_3" = "#FC8F24",
  "Region_4" = "#dcaa38",
  "Region_5" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Region_6" = "#98a25a",
  "Region_7" = "#747428",
  "Region_8" = "#627391",
  "Region_9" = "#8d61a9"
)

# Clean color names to match cleaned labels
rgn_colors_clean <- setNames(
  rgn_colors,
  gsub("_", " ", names(rgn_colors))
)

mangrove_all_years <- gmw_area |>
  mutate(
    region_clean = gsub("_", " ", rgn_id)
  )

ggplot(
  mangrove_all_years,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = area_km2,
    group = region_clean,
    color = region_clean
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rgn_colors_clean) +
  labs(
    title = "Mangrove Extent Over Time (GMW 1996–2020)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mangrove Extent (km²)",
    color = "Region ID"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```
